notes.title: New Mechanics and Sprites
notes.content:
With the launch of the Episode 2 page, we’ve updated the build of Episode 1.

[b]New ending mechanic:[/b]
If you reach one of the alternative endings with character epilogues, there won’t be a final screen with text and links anymore. Instead, you’ll see a button that takes you back to the start of the key scene.
This makes it clear: that ending isn’t canon, and the story can still go another way.

We often saw streamers thinking they had “finished” the game on the allergy ending or the pregnancy interruption. Technically, those are endings too, but they aren’t canon and won’t lead into Episode 2.

The final screen with links now only appears after the true ending of Episode 1.

[b]What else:[/b]

📌 Some backgrounds were extended, and now in certain scenes the camera moves more actively.

📌 At the party, we added a new angle when Lida drinks — making it easier to feel her first-time experience.

📌 Updated Max’s standing sprite: fists are now more realistic (before, they looked way too huge).

📌 Fixed bugs in the localizations.

📌 And the big one — added the ability to scroll TikTok while waiting for Lekha on the date. You can also distract yourself with it when Yulia overwhelms you with stories about her beloved Wheeze.

📌 Added new sprites of Lida and Lekha together, so it doesn’t look like they’re “randomly still dressed.”

notes.title: The Episode 2 store page is now live!
notes.content:
[p][b]We’ve just opened the Steam store page for [i]“I’m Pregnant at 16: Episode 2”[/i]! 🎉[/b][/p][p]For now, all in-game screenshots are in Russian, as the episode is still in development — but just like Episode 1, it will be fully localized by the time of release.[/p][p]Episode 2 is already more than halfway done, and we’re working hard to finish it on time.
We’re incredibly excited for the release and can’t wait to hear your feedback and see your reactions.
This episode has taken much more time, ideas, and effort than the first, and we’re confident it will be a big step up.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Please consider adding the DLC to your wishlist — it really helps with visibility and promotion 💙[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3909910/YA_beremenna_v_16_Epizod_2/"][/dynamiclink][b]


[/b][/p]

notes.title: Big update to the main game.
notes.content:
📌 [b]Lore changes[/b]
Milana is now the older sister.
Lida is no longer preparing for final exams — it confused many players, and we listened.

📌 [b]New character emotions[/b]
Grumpy Lida and shy Lyokha have been added.
We’re working on making the characters’ reactions more expressive and lively.

📌 [b]3D background animation[/b]
Some scenes now have AI-powered animated backgrounds.
We know many feel skeptical about AI — if it doesn’t work for you, we’ll remove it.

📌 [b]Spanish localization[/b]
The game is now fully translated into Spanish.
Scenes, images, and dialogues have been adapted to local culture.

📌 [b]DLC update[/b]
Updated backgrounds to match the current version, added some exclusive content and new character animations from the epilogue.

notes.title: New sprites, backgrounds, and animations!
notes.content:
[b]It’s been a while since the last update — because we’ve been fully focused on Episode 2. But here’s what we managed to get done:[/b]

[i]Lyoha now has a smartphone in his hand — in scenes where it's needed by the script.

Lida now holds a drink at the party.

On the bus, Lyoha’s “accidental” touch of Lida’s chest is now a bit more obvious.

Fixed a bug: Lida no longer says Max can’t take a punch if you manage to get through the date without a fight or chocolate disaster.

Many scenes now have added animations and emotion changes — characters feel more alive.

Most of the backgrounds in the character epilogues were recreated and improved.[/i]

[b]Thanks for following the project ❤️[/b]

notes.title: Background and Sprite Update
notes.content:
While we’re actively working on the continuation of the story, we’re not forgetting about the base game. Today, we’re releasing a small but important update.

✨ What’s changed:

Improved backgrounds
— We’ve reworked and updated several backgrounds. They now look sharper, cleaner, and more pleasant.

Visible signs of violence and slaps
— Max now has bruises after being beaten.
— Lyosha gets a slap mark from Lida if that choice was made.
— If Max gets splashed with hot chocolate — the stain remains on his sprite.

New items in the protagonist’s hands
— In specific scenes, Lida now holds a cup of hot chocolate and an energy drink can.

Animated party background
— To better match the vibe of our favorite track, the party background is now animated.

Cosmetic fixes
— As usual, we’ve fixed bugs in the code and text. Dialogue lines should no longer overflow the text box. (If they do — let us know!)

And finally:
We know many of you have already left a review on our game — thank you so much! But if you haven’t yet, please consider doing so. It really helps us grow the project, reach new players, and keep going.

notes.title: Update and message to the players
notes.content:
This time, we’ve added two major changes:

[b]1. Max is now fully drawn![/b]
We’ve finally replaced the neural-network-generated Max with a fully illustrated character. Now, except for the conductor, all characters in the game are hand-drawn and alive.

[b]2. Reworked background in Lekha’s room[/b]
The scene in his room has been redesigned. You can now explore it more closely, interact with some of his personal items, and learn more about Lekha.

[b]In addition:[/b]
— fixed minor bugs, as usual
— improved English and Chinese localizations

[b]Now a few words for those waiting for the continuation.[/b]

Yes, we’re regularly updating the main game, and it might seem like we’re stuck at this stage. But the continuation is being developed in parallel — the work on the base game doesn’t interfere with it.
We launched the game in Early Access exactly so we could calmly finish everything we planned and implement new mechanics and ideas — both those we couldn’t include in the initial release and those that emerged during development.

Our team consists of just three people. Each of us has a day job, and we work on the game in our free time. So yes, to play a proper second episode, you’ll need to wait a bit longer.

Thank you for supporting us, leaving kind reviews, and sharing your experience and any issues — it really helps the development.

notes.title: Chinese Localization
notes.content:
[b]Today, we're releasing an update with full localization of the game into Chinese. [/b]

The translation wasn’t easy, but we believe it turned out authentic enough for Chinese players to comfortably immerse themselves in the story.

Of course, along with the localization, we’ve also made various tweaks and improvements, though most of them will likely go unnoticed.

notes.title: Update: Now They Blink!
notes.content:
We continue to improve "Sixteen and Pregnant"!
This update includes several noticeable changes that make the game more lively, convenient, and rich.

The main new feature is character blinking.
Now the characters look more alive, and the scenes less static.

The cinema scene has been reworked.
Choosing a movie has become simpler and more elegant, and most importantly — now, when Lyokha starts making moves, you can shift your attention to the screen and actually watch what's playing.

In addition, we’ve made some smaller fixes:

• Updated the style of character names.
• Removed Lida’s third reply to “What’s that?” — this is needed for progression.
• The link to our channel at the end of the game is now clickable.
• A new sticker has been added to the collection.
• All text bugs in the English version have been fixed.

notes.title: "I'm 16 and Pregnant" Update — Weekly Summary
notes.content:
[b]We've released a new update and would like to share what’s changed over the past week:[/b]

1. Completely removed a dangerous five-letter word from the game.

2. The second epilogue scene with Yulia now only appears if the player actively interacted with her.

3. Fixed a bug in the café scene where Lida mistakenly said one of Yulia’s lines.

4. Removed the second stove in the kitchen — it previously raised questions among players.

5. Mom will now remember your choice in the conversation about contraception.

6. Lida’s phone appearance has been updated.

7. The fight scene between Lyokha and Max has been reworked: new illustrations added and the action made more dynamic.

8. Several sound effects have been adjusted.

9. Turns out the game icon had been in low resolution all this time. Fixed.

10. English adaptation may still occasionally display incorrectly — we’re working on it.

notes.title: Weekly Update
notes.content:
– The café scene between Lida and Yulia felt too short for many players, so we’ve slightly expanded it.

– The appearance of the Conductor and Max has been reworked. They’re still AI-generated, but now better match the overall visual style of the game.

– Some choices now have a stronger impact on events and character reactions. There aren’t many of these yet, but we plan to expand this system further.

– Updated some of the backgrounds in the character epilogues.

– Grandma somehow snuck into one of the story branches again, so we had to cut her out — for real this time.

– Filled in missing lines in the English version. A full edit of the translation is still ahead — we're working on it.

notes.title: Недельное обновление
notes.content:
Список основных изменений:

🔹  Номер версии теперь всегда виден
Теперь в правом верхнем углу экрана отображается версия игры — это, скорее, для нас, но и вам будет удобно следить за актуальностью сборки.

🔹 Обновлён финальный экран
Многие игроки случайно пропускали послесловие о персонажах, сразу выходя в главное меню. Теперь финал стал более плавным, и важные сцены вряд ли кто-то пропустит.

🔹 Редактура текста первой половины игры (до сцены на вписке)
Мы тщательно переработали и вычитали текст, исправили опечатки и стилистические ошибки. Надеемся, что сейчас читать стало комфортнее. Если всё же что-то упустили — будем благодарны за обратную связь.
